fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/247762/rates (2026, 2027 and 2028 seasons: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $30) + https://www.nps.gov/cato/planyourvisit/fees.htm ('An entrance pass is not required to access Catoctin Mountain Park.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reservation only, up to 6 months ahead on Recreation.gov ('No walk-in sites are available'); bookable through the day of arrival. 7 consecutive nights at most and 14 nights a year. Five people (or the immediate family) and one vehicle a site; the vehicle must fit on the parking pad, with overflow parking at the entrance. Check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/247762 (notice: 'Book Campsite reservations up to 6 months in advance online through Recreation.gov. No walk-in sites are available.'; facility_rules maxConsecutiveStay 7 consecutive nights, maxStay 14 nights Each Year, reservationCutOff 0 days; occupancy and check-out notices), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/247762 ('There are no-hookups.'; notice: 'The campground has no hook-ups or dump station.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: No dump station; the closest is in Cunningham Falls State Park. Firewood is sold in the campground; utility sinks for dishes.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/247762 ('Flush toilets, showers and drinking water are available and centrally located in the campground.'; 'The campground has no hook-ups or dump station. The closest dump station is located in Cunningham Falls State Park.'; 'Firewood is available in the campground.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 48 single sites. 'Trailers over 22 ft. (6.7 m) and Class A, B, C recreational vehicles over 30 ft. (9.1 m) are prohibited.' The three pull-through sites (#12, #39, #43) are the RV sites; the rest are tent pads (the recreation.gov catalog marks only two sites for RVs and trailers).

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/247762 ('This campground offers 48 single campsites'; 'Maximum trailer length is 22 feet (6.4 m) and maximum RV length is 30 feet (9 m). There are three pull through sites: #12, #39 and #43.'; length notice) + recreation.gov per-site catalog (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20), read 2026-10-21

note: NPS, Catoctin Mountain Park near Thurmont/Sabillasville MD. Mostly tent-oriented - only the three pull-through sites take RVs, so RV-usable but limited. Owens Creek (a small stream) runs through the area but sites are not on the water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $30 (2026-2028 rate seasons), no hookups, reservation-only on rec.gov 6 months ahead, 48 sites, 30-ft RV limit (trailers 22 ft), pull-throughs; all now manual. Added 7-night consecutive limit (14 a year), flush toilets/showers/drinking water, no dump. Note trimmed of what the fields hold (site count, reservation-only, hookups, lengths). No rec.gov minimum stay. Not stated: campground season (rate seasons only; NPS's campground page renders by script).
flags: Fit (lead only): only three pull-through sites take RVs, and recreation.gov's per-site catalog marks just two (site 12 and one other) for RVs/trailers, with every site's Max Vehicle Length 22 ft while the description allows RVs to 30 ft. EKKO (23-ft motorhome) is within the stated 30-ft RV limit; the 22-ft limit is for trailers.
